desc: The Techna Clip is an excellent carry option that eliminates the excess bulk often found with IWB Holster. Techna Clips are well made using high quality carbon steel and install quickly. This easy to use carry option is versatile and economical to suite any shooters needs. Techna Clip for your pistol is one of the most powerful weapons for conceal carry that you can find. Conceal this weapon and you will always feel protected. Techna Clip provides the way to truly conceal your pistol.
